description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Mental Mutation

You carry a searing rage that has consumed almost all of your other ways to express negative emotions, such as grief, fear and anxiety. Strong negative emotions will make you explode into a fit of rage unless you manage to suppress it. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.hXcfygzujgyMN1uI]{Frenzy} Talent. At the 1st level you gain temporary Animosity towards your target, which doesn’t have to result in violence. At 2nd level you gain @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.E98mVLZgE8bX5vQW]{Hatred} instead which most certainly will. People that know you quickly learn not to jest at your expense.
